name: Ogawa (Saitama, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Ogawa town emblem in red: a ring of concentric lines enclosing a stylised drop with two points.
history: Municipal flag of Ogawa, a town in Saitama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 July 1973.

features.role: Ogawa town emblem — a ring of concentric lines enclosing a stylised drop with two points
